book.title: Essentialism: The Disciplined Pursuit of Less
book.author: Greg McKeown

confidence_note: The reference TR text frames this story around military history: armies spread across many fronts lose, while those concentrating force on one point win, and calls it a 'single-ship fleet'. This historical framing cannot be confirmed in Essentialism and is not used. The book's own image for the same idea is a simple diagram: energy spread across many directions produces a little progress in each, while the same energy focused in one essential direction produces much greater progress. McKeown also discusses the 'essential intent', a single clear, inspiring and concrete decision that makes many future decisions easier. Both are described without direct quotation.
facts: McKeown uses a simple image: the same amount of energy, split across many activities, produces a millimeter of progress in a hundred directions.
When that energy is focused on a few essential things, or one, it produces much greater progress in the direction that matters.
He argues many people and organizations feel busy and exhausted but make little real progress because their energy is scattered.
He describes an 'essential intent': a single, concrete and inspiring goal that makes a thousand later decisions simpler, because anything that doesn't serve it can be declined.
He argues that clarity of purpose is what makes focus possible.
tension: Why do busy people and busy teams often make so little progress?
opening_idea: Draw arrows pointing in a dozen directions, each tiny. Now draw one long arrow. Same energy, very different result.
reflect: In how many directions is your energy going right now?
What would your essential intent be for this year?
reflect_final: If you could move only one arrow forward this quarter, which would it be?

use_cases.move: Agree on one essential intent for the quarter and drop or pause what doesn't serve it.

use_cases.situation: You're juggling several side projects with little progress.
use_cases.move: Choose one and pause the others for three months.

use_cases.situation: A report is spread thin across many initiatives.
use_cases.move: Help them pick the one where they can make the biggest contribution.

pocket_idea: The same energy goes much further in one direction than in a hundred.

conversation_variants.punchline_idea: A hundred small efforts in different directions add up to almost nothing.
conversation_variants.thirty_sec_idea: Scattered versus focused energy, essential intent.
conversation_variants.question_idea: In how many directions is your energy going?
